lines.zh: 扇动透明翅膀，无声地飘向远方。
lines.en: Flickers on silken wings, silently drifting away.

lines.zh: 身体轻盈如烟，飘忽地前进。
lines.en: Body ghostly light, ethereal and forward.

lines.zh: 翅膀快速振动，快速移动。
lines.en: Wings vibrate fast, moving swiftly.

lines.zh: 缓慢地扇动翅膀，优雅地前进。
lines.en: Slowly flaps wings, graceful movement.

lines.zh: 翅膀在空中轻轻划过。
lines.en: Wings softly trace through the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻盈地拍打着夜幕。
lines.en: Wings gently flutter in the dusk.

lines.zh: 飘忽地在空中游荡。
lines.en: Drifts aimlessly in the air.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中无声地滑行。
lines.en: Silently glides in the darkness.

lines.zh: 轻巧地在空中飘动。
lines.en: Lightly drifts in the air.

lines.zh: 在微风中轻轻摇曳。
lines.en: Gently sways in the breeze.

lines.zh: 掠过天境浮岛的边缘。
lines.en: It skims the edge of a sky island.

lines.zh: 翅膀切开稀薄的高空风。
lines.en: Wings slice the thin high air.

lines.zh: 静静地停在空中。
lines.en: Stops quietly in the air.

lines.zh: 静静地悬浮在黑暗中。
lines.en: Suspends silently in the dark.

lines.zh: 在空中缓缓盘旋。
lines.en: Slowly circles in the air.

lines.zh: 轻巧地停在半空中。
lines.en: Pauses lightly in mid-air.

lines.zh: 静静地悬浮着。
lines.en: Suspends quietly.

lines.zh: 在微光中飘忽。
lines.en: Drifts in the faint light.

lines.zh: 静静地停留在黑暗里。
lines.en: Stops quietly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 在空中缓缓游荡。
lines.en: Drifts slowly in the air.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息在空中。
lines.en: Rests quietly in the air.

lines.zh: 轻巧地在空中徘徊。
lines.en: Pauses lightly in the air.

lines.zh: 停在浮岛的草叶上歇息。
lines.en: It rests on a blade of sky-island grass.

lines.zh: 翅膀在云光里几乎看不见。
lines.en: Its wings almost vanish in cloudlight.

lines.zh: 绕着天根树缓缓打转。
lines.en: It circles a skyroot tree slowly.

lines.zh: 静静悬着，任风托住身体。
lines.en: It hangs still, held up by the wind.

lines.zh: 忽地朝玩家的方向看去。
lines.en: Quickly glances at the player.

lines.zh: 这只编号的蝴蝶，只在你头顶绕。
lines.en: This numbered butterfly circles only above your head.

lines.zh: 朝玩家的方向转动头部。
lines.en: Turns its head towards the player.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家的身影。
lines.en: Fixes its gaze on the player.

lines.zh: 警惕地看向玩家。
lines.en: Looks cautiously at the player.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，似乎在观察。
lines.en: Looks at the player, seemingly observing.

lines.zh: 转头看向玩家的身影。
lines.en: TURNS HEAD TO PLAYER.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，仿佛在思考。
lines.en: Looks at the player, seemingly thinking.

lines.zh: 仔细地观察着玩家。
lines.en: Caresfully observes the player.

lines.zh: 转向玩家，眼神锐利。
lines.en: Turns towards the player, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 它落在你的护目镜上。
lines.en: It lands on your goggles.

lines.zh: 翅膀的影子扫过你的脸。
lines.en: Its wing shadow sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 它绕着你转了一圈。
lines.en: It circles once around you.

lines.zh: 它在你肩头停下又飞起。
lines.en: It settles on your shoulder, then lifts.

lines.zh: 它停在你伸出的手指上。
lines.en: It lands on your offered finger.

lines.zh: 它被你的呼吸惊得一顿。
lines.en: Your breath makes it falter.

lines.zh: 它顺着你上方的气流飘来。
lines.en: It drifts down the current above you.

lines.zh: 它绕开你，又飘回来。
lines.en: It swerves past you, then drifts back.

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，飞不快了。
lines.en: Wings hurt, can't fly fast.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，快点救救我。
lines.en: I'm hurt, save me.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了，飞不高了。
lines.en: Wings damaged, can't fly high.

lines.zh: 身体受伤，动不了了。
lines.en: Injured, can't move.

lines.zh: 翅膜破了个口，我跌进草丛。
lines.en: A hole in my wing membrane drops me into the grass.

lines.zh: 翅膀坏了，飞不动了。
lines.en: Wings broken, can't fly.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，快来帮我。
lines.en: I'm hurt, help me.

lines.zh: 翅膀受创，飞不稳了。
lines.en: Wings injured, can't fly steady.

lines.zh: 受伤了，快治治我。
lines.en: I'm hurt, heal me.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了，只能落在天境草上。
lines.en: My wing is torn, so I settle on the Aether grass.

lines.zh: 它那透明的翅膀诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: Its transparent wings tempt you closer.

lines.zh: 你被它的光点吸引过去。
lines.en: Its glowing spots draw you in.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛仿佛在观察你。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to study you.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻触你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its antennae touch your skin gently.

lines.zh: 它的声音像低语一般温柔。
lines.en: Its voice is a gentle whisper.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀闪烁着微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Its wings emit a faint glow.

lines.zh: 它的美丽令人无法抗拒。
lines.en: Its beauty is irresistible.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵轻微的电击。
lines.en: You feel a mild electric shock.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边呢喃着什么。
lines.en: It whispers in your ear.

lines.zh: 它追着一片飘落的花瓣。
lines.en: It chases a falling petal.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的透明翅膀。
lines.en: You collide with its transparent wings.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你身上划过。
lines.en: Its wings slide over you.

lines.zh: 你撞到了一个发光的点。
lines.en: You hit a glowing spot.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀擦过你的脸。
lines.en: Its wings brush your face.

lines.zh: 你的衣服粘在了它的翅膀上。
lines.en: Your clothes stick to its wings.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀夹住了你的手臂。
lines.en: Its wings trap your arm.

lines.zh: 你被它带到了空中。
lines.en: You are carried aloft by it.

lines.zh: 它扇动翅膀把你推开了。
lines.en: It pushes you away with its wings.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你身上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its wings leave marks on you.

lines.zh: 你被一阵风带走了。
lines.en: You are carried away by a breeze.

lines.zh: 它寻找着配偶进行交配。
lines.en: It seeks a mate for mating.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀发出求偶信号。
lines.en: Its wings emit mating signals.

lines.zh: 它在空中追逐另一个个体。
lines.en: It chases another individual in the air.

lines.zh: 它试图靠近另一个个体。
lines.en: It tries to get close to another individual.

lines.zh: 它用触角轻触对方的身体。
lines.en: It uses its antennae to touch the other's body.

lines.zh: 它的声音变得更为温柔。
lines.en: Its voice becomes more gentle.

lines.zh: 它在空中环绕着另一个个体。
lines.en: It circles another individual in the air.

lines.zh: 它试图用触须接触对方。
lines.en: It tries to touch the other with its antennae.

lines.zh: 它在寻找交配的时机。
lines.en: It searches for mating opportunities.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在对方身边闪烁。
lines.en: Its wings emit a glow around the other.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地落在你肩上，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: It gracefully lands on your shoulder, producing a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 你感觉到了它翅膀的轻触。
lines.en: You feel the gentle touch of its wings.

lines.zh: 它的小触角触碰你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its tiny antennae tap your skin.

lines.zh: 它在你头发间穿梭，发出细微的声音。
lines.en: It darts through your hair, making a faint noise.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你耳边轻轻振动。
lines.en: Its wings vibrate softly near your ear.

lines.zh: 它在你手上轻盈地跳跃。
lines.en: It lightly jumps on your hand.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的温度，微微颤抖。
lines.en: You feel its warmth, shivering slightly.

lines.zh: 它在你周围翩翩起舞。
lines.en: It dances around you.

lines.zh: 它在你衣物上滑动。
lines.en: It slides across your clothing.

lines.zh: 它的触手轻轻触碰你的手指。
lines.en: Its tentacles gently touch your fingers.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意，它在追踪你。
lines.en: You feel a chill as it tracks you.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地靠近，目光锐利。
lines.en: It silently approaches with sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中闪烁，准备攻击。
lines.en: It glows in the dark, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的目光如冰，盯着你。
lines.en: Its gaze is icy, fixing on you.

lines.zh: 它从阴影中出现，盯着你。
lines.en: It emerges from the shadows, staring at you.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕你的身体。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your body.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，表明敌意。
lines.en: It hisses, showing hostility.

lines.zh: 我身上的光一亮，翅膀全展开。
lines.en: The light on me flares as I spread my wings wide.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在暗处，等待机会。
lines.en: It lurks in the shadows, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它发出咯咯声，表明不友好。
lines.en: It makes a cackling sound, indicating unfriendliness.

lines.zh: 它盯上了你手里的花。
lines.en: It fixes on the flower in your hand.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，它朝你俯冲。
lines.en: Wings folding, it dives at you.

lines.zh: 它在你的影子里找到了空隙。
lines.en: It finds a gap inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 它贴着地面掠过你的脚边。
lines.en: It skims the ground past your feet.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后，悄无声息。
lines.en: It slips behind you without a sound.

lines.zh: 一片鳞粉落在你的皮肤上。
lines.en: A fleck of wing dust lands on your skin.

lines.zh: 它锁定目标，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It locks on, hissing.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: It stares at you, emitting a faint glow.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你的手腕。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your wrist.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，似乎要攻击。
lines.en: It hisses, as if to attack.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，我锁定你了。
lines.en: One wingbeat and I've locked on you.

lines.zh: 它发出轻微的嘶嘶声，锁定目标。
lines.en: It hisses softly, locking on to you.

lines.zh: 它的触手开始向你延伸。
lines.en: Its tentacles begin to extend towards you.

lines.zh: 它凝视你，准备攻击。
lines.en: It gazes at you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你的颈部。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your neck.

lines.zh: 它发出咯咯声，锁定目标。
lines.en: It makes a cackling sound, locking on to you.

lines.zh: 它悬在你面前，一动不动的。
lines.en: It hovers before you, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 翅膀慢慢张开，像一把刀。
lines.en: Its wings open slowly like a blade.

lines.zh: 它顺着你的气息压低高度。
lines.en: It drops lower along your scent.

lines.zh: 它数着你眨眼的次数。
lines.en: It counts every blink you make.

lines.zh: 它停在你够不到的地方。
lines.en: It settles just beyond your reach.

lines.zh: 它绕着你的头顶缓缓收紧。
lines.en: It circles your head, closing in.

lines.zh: 空气里浮起一层薄薄的鳞粉。
lines.en: A thin dust of scales fills the air.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，又前进两步。
lines.en: It retreats one step, then takes two.

lines.zh: 它挥动着透明翅膀向你袭来。
lines.en: It swoops at you with its translucent wings.

lines.zh: 它的触须突然伸长，咬向你的手臂。
lines.en: Its long proboscis extends to bite your arm.

lines.zh: 它迅速扇动翅膀，试图击退你。
lines.en: It flutters its wings, trying to push you away.

lines.zh: 它的触角缠住了你的腿，试图拖走你。
lines.en: Its antennae grab your leg, trying to drag you away.

lines.zh: 它扇动翅膀，试图用毒刺扎伤你。
lines.en: It flaps its wings, trying to sting you with its needles.

lines.zh: 它用透明的翅膀拍打你，试图击昏你。
lines.en: It slaps you with its translucent wings, trying to knock you out.

lines.zh: 它的触角紧紧抱住你的喉咙。
lines.en: Its antennae grip your throat tightly.

lines.zh: 它扇动翅膀，想要击倒你。
lines.en: It flaps its wings, trying to knock you down.

lines.zh: 它的触角缠绕在你的手臂上。
lines.en: Its antennae wrap around your arm.

lines.zh: 它用透明翅膀扇打你，试图控制你。
lines.en: It slaps you with its translucent wings, trying to control you.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘划过你的手臂。
lines.en: A wing edge slices your arm.

lines.zh: 它一头撞在你护甲上。
lines.en: It rams headfirst into your armor.

lines.zh: 鳞粉糊住了你的眼睛。
lines.en: Wing dust blinds your eyes.

lines.zh: 它用细足抓紧你的衣领。
lines.en: Its thin legs clutch your collar.

lines.zh: 翅膀猛地一扇，把你掀开。
lines.en: One hard wingbeat shoves you back.

lines.zh: 它贴着你耳边振翅嘶鸣。
lines.en: It whirs and hisses at your ear.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶在黑暗中悄然出现。
lines.en: The Sky境 butterfly appears silently in the dark.

lines.zh: 它从洞穴中缓缓飞出。
lines.en: It slowly flies out from the cave.

lines.zh: 一只天境蝴蝶突然从荆棘中飞出。
lines.en: A Sky境 butterfly suddenly flies out from the thorns.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶在废墟的阴影中徘徊。
lines.en: The Sky境 butterfly wanders in the shadow of the ruins.

lines.zh: 一只天境蝴蝶在夜幕下悄然出现。
lines.en: A Sky境 butterfly appears silently under the night sky.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶在腐烂的树枝上栖息。
lines.en: The Sky境 butterfly rests on decaying branches.

lines.zh: 它在阴暗的洞穴中徘徊。
lines.en: It wanders in the dark caves.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶在废弃的神庙中飘荡。
lines.en: The Sky境 butterfly drifts in the abandoned temple.

lines.zh: 一只天境蝴蝶在月光下翩翩起舞。
lines.en: A Sky境 butterfly dances under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它在荒废的村庄上空盘旋。
lines.en: It circles over the abandoned village.

lines.zh: 天境的花丛里飞出一只。
lines.en: One rises from an Aether flower patch.

lines.zh: 它从云端落到浮岛上。
lines.en: It drops from the clouds onto a sky island.

lines.zh: 透明的翅膀在日光里显形。
lines.en: Clear wings take shape in daylight.

lines.zh: 编号第二的那只振翅而出。
lines.en: Variant two beats its wings awake.

lines.zh: 它从岛底的气流里升上来。
lines.en: It rises on air from beneath the island.

lines.zh: 一只幼虫在天根木上化蝶。
lines.en: A larva becomes a butterfly on skyroot.

lines.zh: 高空的风把它送了过来。
lines.en: The high wind carries it here.

lines.zh: 它在金枫叶间悄然现身。
lines.en: It appears quietly among golden leaves.

lines.zh: 火伤了翅膀，好疼！
lines.en: Burned wings, hurts!

lines.zh: 掉下来，翅膀受伤了。
lines.en: Fallen, wings hurt.

lines.zh: 淹死了，翅膀全碎了。
lines.en: Drowned, wings broken.

lines.zh: 爆炸，翅膀被炸伤了。
lines.en: Exploded, wings hurt.

lines.zh: 中箭，翅膀受伤了。
lines.en: Hit by arrow, wings hurt.

lines.zh: 咒语伤了翅膀，疼死我了。
lines.en: Magic hit wings, hurts.

lines.zh: 饿坏了，翅膀无力。
lines.en: Starved, wings weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈中翅膀，好疼！
lines.en: Lightning hit wings, hurts.

lines.zh: 坠入虚无，翅膀全毁。
lines.en: Void, wings broken.
